meta.title: Backroom A+B — nine source-checked description replacements (research only)
meta.writing_style: Natural visitor advice, source-specific physical detail, evidence strength, current access; no mandatory Where/Best times/Crowd/Watch out sections.
meta.source_limit: Some original directory URLs cannot be opened currently; original content was preserved in the 92-record GitHub audit. Each record explicitly notes direct/archived evidence state.

records.name: The Mall (Tsarigradsko Shose)
records.description: The Mall sits on Tsarigradsko Shose Boulevard in Sofia’s Mladost district, and the cruising reference is specifically to the toilets on underground level −2—not Sofia Ring Mall or Mall of Sofia. The original listing marks evenings as its preferred period, but its more recent comments are men asking who is around or trying to arrange a meeting, rather than reports of something actually happening. The centre has multiple underground parking levels and is normally open for shopping until 22:00. It may be worth knowing about if you’re already there, but there’s no reliable evidence of a regular cruising crowd or a particularly productive time. It’s an ordinary, managed shopping-centre toilet, so the layout, security and access can change.

records.name: Nissi Beach
records.description: Nissi Beach is one of Ayia Napa’s busiest sandy resort beaches, with beach bars, music, sunbeds and water sports around its shallow bay. It is easy to reach from Nissi Avenue, but that popularity is also the limitation of this cruising listing: the directory discussions from June 2026 are requests to meet, and none identifies a recognisable gay cruising section or reports a confirmed encounter. It’s a holidaymakers’ beach rather than a known men-only or naturist spot, so someone looking specifically for discreet cruising has little concrete information to go on. Note that Cyprus tourism distinguishes Nissi Beach from the neighbouring Nissi Bay Beach and its famous sandbar; the previous pin was on Nissi Bay, not Nissi Beach.

records.name: Parking Area near Big Greek Flag
records.description: This Paphos entry describes a seafront parking area by a prominent Greek flag. The important practical detail is that the original cruising page actually provides a mapped driving destination at 34.816551, 32.392544; it is not an entirely unlocated spot, as the previous description suggested. The older contributor description says it’s chiefly a place where people meet in cars, with very little privacy and fewer men passing on foot. One 2025 commenter described morning visits, but the more recent June 2026 comments only ask about meeting, so don’t count on those older hours still meaning much. The source pin identifies a starting point, not independently verified legal parking bays, and the exact flag landmark or current access still needs local confirmation.

records.name: Tripla Toilets
records.description: Tripla is the huge shopping and railway complex at Pasila station in Helsinki. The cruising directory names its toilets but doesn’t say which floor or toilet bank, which is the biggest problem if someone actually wants to find the place. A May 2026 post asks whether anybody is there; that is recent interest, not proof of cruising. Tripla’s operator says pedestrian routes are generally open 06:00–24:00, while a first-floor supermarket passage stays accessible around the clock. That does not make every toilet open 24 hours, so the previous description was too generous about overnight access. Until there’s a better toilet location or a firsthand recent account, this is more of a tentative lead than somewhere I’d recommend travelling across Helsinki for.

records.name: Ponte fiume Reno a Borgo Panigale
records.description: This is not an unidentified bridge. The original Italian directory points to the riverside park underneath Bologna’s Pontelungo, where Via Emilia Ponente meets Via del Triumvirato in Borgo Panigale. It describes cruising on foot around the bridge and park and historically mentions paid encounters, though those older statements say nothing reliable about the present crowd. The original driving-map reference is 44.511105, 11.291295. Pontelungo’s roadworks have been completed, but a reopened road does not verify that the riverside paths below remain unchanged. The May 2026 directory message was simply asking who might be there at night, not reporting an encounter. Use the bridge and river park as the location reference rather than treating any random Reno crossing as equivalent.

records.name: Parking Murcki
records.description: The Polish directory describes a parking area behind the MOL petrol station in Katowice-Murcki, on the road towards Mysłowice–Stara Wesoła. If you’re trying to find it, use the station as a landmark rather than assuming its forecourt is the cruising spot. More importantly, MOL’s own station list gives the address as ul. Pawła Kołodzieja 10 and the station position as 50.197800, 19.051901; the previous description used number 86 from a third-party listing. The directory has older references to evening activity and a more recent online presence message, but no independently confirmed current pattern. The parking area behind the station is still not precisely identified, and access to neighbouring lots may be restricted.

records.name: Aquadrom Pool
records.description: Aquadrom is a public water park in Ruda Śląska, not Katowice, and the cruising claims are about the steam sauna rather than the swimming pools. The original directory recommends Saturday mornings and mentions men using the sauna, but its own old popularity ratings are not proof that it is busy now. June 2026 posts are more useful: one man described a good visit to the steam room, while another reported finding little happening during a late-morning visit. That mixed evidence suggests some interest without a dependable peak. You pay for a normal aquatic-centre visit here, and the saunarium has its own schedule: Monday–Wednesday from 12:00, Thursday–Friday from 10:00, weekends from 09:00, generally closing at 22:00. It isn’t a gay cruising sauna, so respect the facility’s rules and other users.

records.name: Antvorskov Syd
records.description: Antvorskov has two E20 rest areas outside Slagelse, but this directory entry points most clearly to the southern side, Antvorskov Syd. The original map destination at 55.398716, 11.380720 matches independently mapped Syd, and a source commenter specifically named that side. The older description also refers to bushes west of the toilets and gives a road direction that can be read ambiguously, so the correct signed approach matters far more than simply entering 'Antvorskov' in a satnav. Early 2026 posts include meeting invitations and one visitor saying nobody arrived. That’s not enough to promise an active crowd or reliable hours. Antvorskov Nord is a different motorway entrance; do not use the Syd pin as directions to both.

records.name: Parking río Llobregat El Prat
records.description: This is a specific riverside car park in El Prat de Llobregat, not just an anonymous stretch of the river. The original Spanish directions say to leave the C-31 at exit 194B when coming from Barcelona, go to the roundabout and follow the access road towards the Llobregat, with a small parking area on the right. The original directory map destination is 41.336864, 2.096415. That gives a much better location reference than the old description, which incorrectly said no car park, bridge or approach could be identified. The August 2026 source signal was only a digital check-in, so it does not establish actual cruising or busy hours. Check local road signs and river protection restrictions rather than assuming every unmarked vehicle track is public.
